Is travel to Morocco safe for women?   Generally, I would say yes, it is definitely a safe place for women to travel, and I think the bad reputation mainly comes from Marrakesh. There are so many amazing cities to visit in Morocco. Where should you visit in Morocco? Fes is one city that I really loved. Another city to visit in Morocco? Definitely go to Essaouira, but also to Casablanca, and Tangier. Do not forget about the desert! The best desert I’ve been to in potentially my life is in Merzouga! Make sure you do not go to the Agafay desert… you need to make sure you go to the further desert because it is absolutely gorgeous   I do think that I explain in my video, however, it goes a little bit deeper than just a city having small streets and being uncomfortable, because of the way that men act I think it is directly tied tourism , so while I would not say avoid Marrakesh, I would just say, be vigilant and ignore, and that speak to you if you’re alone. The bottom line is travel to Morocco is safe. Tourism and Morocco is safe. Moroccans are very kind in hospital people, so should you travel to Morocco? Yes. Morocco is safe for solo female travelers. Nobody Tells You This About Morocco 🇲🇦 Morocco isn’t just a destination… it’s a feeling you don’t expect until you’ve experienced it.  Everyone talks about Marrakech and the Sahara, but nobody tells you how every corner of this country surprises you in its own way. In Chefchaouen, time slows down as you wander through blue streets that feel almost unreal. In Fes, you step back centuries into a living maze where tradition is still alive in every detail. Nobody tells you how peaceful the Atlantic feels in Essaouira, or how the sunsets in Agadir paint the sky in colors you’ve never seen before. And then there’s the silence of the Sahara Desert… not empty, but full of something you can’t quite explain. But the real secret? It’s the people. Moroccan hospitality isn’t just kindness, it’s a way of life. Tea is never just tea, it’s an invitation. A conversation. A connection. Morocco is contrast: - Ancient medinas and modern cities   - Mountains and ocean   - Chaos and calm, And somehow, it all works together perfectly. So if you’re planning a trip… don’t just visit Morocco. Experience it 🇲🇦 #Moroc#Moroccot#VisitMoroccoe#TravelMoroccoccanExperience #wanderly
